bibl.title: The Location and Size of Prektis in the Hermopolite nome
bibl.seg: Ryosuke Takahashi, The Location and Size of Prektis in the Hermopolite Nome.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 4 (2023) §1-8, figg.
bibl.note: Argues that Prektis was a substantial settlement located on the west side of the Nile rather than on the east side.
